GO, DUCKS, GO
David Harvey nets plastic ducks at the finish line on Saturday May 7 2022 along the spring-fed stream at Lake Atalanta Park in Rogers during the Ducky Derby fundraiser for Spay Arkansas. Some 1,000 ducks were available for adoption and entry into the race at $10 for one duck, $25 for a six "quack" of ducks and $45 for six ducks and a souvenir shirt. Each duck was numbered and the first duck to cross the finish line was good for the $500 grand prize. All 1,000 ducks were adopted for the race, said Shonna Harvey, executive director of Spay Arkansas. Melissa Warden won the grand prize, Trey Harvey's duck was second and Marci Schroeder's duck placed third. Go to nwaonline.com/220508Daily/ to see more photos.
